notes.title: Gamepad Update!
notes.content:
Now you can use Gamepad in this game!
The kinds of gamepad you can use in this game is below.
・PlayStation controller
・Xboxone360
・Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
Please check it out!!

notes.title: Important Notice Regarding Gamepad Operation
notes.content:
Currently, only some of the functions in Magnecution are pad compatible.
If you enable pad operation in the menu and result screens, a serious error may occur, so we have disabled pad operation in the menu and result screens.
Please be aware of this.
During gameplay (character control), we have implemented pad control as planned.
We believe that all gamepads supported by Steam can be used by using Steam's functions.
We have not yet announced the key assignments in the game, and we will fix these issues with the pad update at a later date.
We apologize that we currently recommend using the keyboard and mouse, and that pad control is only an additional factor.
